memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God." ( 1 Corinthians 10:31)

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text: John Wesley’s life stands as a breathtaking testament to what God can accomplish through a completely surrendered vessel. Traveling 20,000 miles a year on horseback, preaching 800 sermons annually, and penning more than 400 separate works, Wesley refused to let a single moment be wasted. Yet, his incredible productivity was never about sheer human willpower; it flowed from a deep, unquenchable fire for the kingdom of God. His writings and sermons were intentionally designed to touch people right where they lived, bridging profound theological truth with practical everyday transformation. When we look at his staggering legacy of spiritual bounty, we are reminded that God is ready to multiply our time, energy, and talents when we offer them unreservedly for His glory.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "Do all the good you can, by all the means you can, in all the ways you can, in all the places you can, at all the times you can, to all the people you can, as long as ever you can."  John Wesley

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, thank You for the remarkable life and legacy of Your servant John Wesley. Pour out a fresh measure of zeal into our hearts today. Help us to redeem our time, use our gifts with purpose, and live lives that touch others right where they are. Multiply our efforts for Your kingdom and keep our spirits fervent in serving You. In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: God has placed unique gifts and a specific calling inside of you. Do not measure your impact by comparing yourself to others, but instead offer your everyday moments, your work, and your words as an act of worship to Him. Step out in faith today, knowing He will strengthen your hands for the journey.
